thread:
alex_truong: Quick follow-up to RFC-347 (fused-attn variants) — proposing a runtime selector + fallback playbook. TL;DR: deterministic selection based on model metadata + runtime heuristics, plus lightweight sanity checks to avoid silent regressions. Draft below, feedback please.

maya_s: high level +1. can we keep the selector pure (no model mutating) and expose decisions in traces? want a compatibility matrix too.

kenji_n: sketch of decision order i'm thinking: 1) model flags (fused_qkv_supported, fused_rope_supported, dropout_free_ok) 2) requested quant/precision 3) seq_len distribution (p95) 4) batch_size 5) device features + kernel availability cache. if any step fails -> next fallback.

lia_ops: telemetry / ops note: we need an event when selector picks a non-default path and a fast histogram of latency, token-per-second, error-rate. also must have a circuit-breaker for noisy failures.

samira_h: question: dropoutless inference path sometimes changes RNG/state assumptions for downstream evals. we should gate rollout on eval-set pass/fail and also run golden prompts to compare top-k logprobs.

kenji_n: fallback levels proposal: 
- level 0: fused-qkv + fused-bias/rope (fastest)
- level 1: fused-qkv only (no fused-rope)
- level 2: fused-bias + separate qkv kernel
- level 3: standard separated q,k,v + bias/rope handled in kernel
- level 4: software emulation / CPU (last resort)
Each fallback emits a short code: FA-P0..FA-P4 in traces.

alex_truong: config snippet proposal (runtime selector):
```yaml
selector:
  prefer_fused: true
  heuristics:
    seq_len_p95_threshold: 512
    min_batch_for_fused: 1
    quant_blacklist: ["int8_dynamic"]
  fallback_policy: ["P0","P1","P2","P3","P4"]
```
(we'll implement default per model but allow overrides per-route).

buildbot: deploy-bot: canary job started for branch fused-selector/playbook (#432) — logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/432

lia_ops: runbook draft for fallback triggers: 1) detect >1% requests hitting P3+ in 5m OR 2) tail latency spike >2x baseline 3) increased gen errors -> auto rollback to previous selector config; manual steps: collect traces -> check FA-Px codes -> escalate to runtime oncall.

samira_h: eval gating: require: BLEU/ROUGE/QA-F1 delta < 0.5% on canonical eval set AND token-prob KL < 0.01 on golden prompts. also add behavioral checks for instruction-following.

kenji_n: sanity checks to run inline (fast): 1) tiny warmup decode on first request after model load (<=50 tokens) comparing outputs between chosen kernel and reference kernel; 2) verify KV cache sizes + offsets; 3) check rope/bias shapes. failures -> immediate fallback + emit FA-ERR code.

alex_truong: ops visibility: expose selector decision + FA-Px code + small sample of logits (hash) in traces. rate-limit sample to 1/1000 requests to avoid PII leakage.

maya_s: integration notes for model onboarding: update model manifest with fused capability flags and a "sanity_harness" command we can run to pre-warm kernels and validate shapes. onboarding checklist item.

lia_ops: also add an alert: "fused-attn-selector-unexpected-fallback-rate" with threshold 0.5%/5m and a runbook link.

kenji_n: implementation plan: selector lives in exec layer (no model changes), kernel availability table + a small LRU cache for recent decisions keyed by (model_id, quant, seq_len_bin, device). fallback code is lightweight and lockless. will send a PR with tests + canary config.

alex_truong: action items: kenji -> prototype selector PR + unit tests; maya -> model-manifest + onboarding checklist update; lia -> formal runbook + alert; samira -> provide eval set + golden prompts; i'll own rollout gates + canary knobs. target: initial canary next week. :rocket: 

maya_s: ack. i'll update agents and add a short design note in docs.

kenji_n: ack, starting on kernel-availability API today.

lia_ops: ack, will draft runbook and alerts by EOD Thu.

samira_h: ack, will share eval artifacts in repo /evals/fused-attn by tomorrow.

alex_truong: Thanks all — if no major objections i'll merge the draft RFC addendum and schedule the canary. ping me if you want to be on the canary review. :thumbsup:
